Are you passionate about quality engineering and eager to make a real impact? Xelvin is seeking an experienced Customer Quality Engineer with a background in electronics to join the engineering team of a leading technology company based in Eindhoven. In this role, you will use your technical expertise to enhance product quality, drive continuous improvement, and contribute directly to innovation and sustainability. About the role This employer designs and builds meaningful technologies that help shape the future. Their solutions contribute to a world where resources are optimized, connectivity unites people, and technology enables everyone to thrive. The company is active in industries such as defense, automotive and medical. Their work spans development, manufacturing (especially electronics), and end-of-life/after-market lifecycle stages. As a Quality Engineer, you will: Be a key figure throughout the entire product life cycle, from sales and product development through serial production to end-of-life. Ensure alignment of the organization with customer requirements and expectations and lead quality discussions both internally and with external stakeholders. Ensure that new products (NPI) meet quality standards from the design phase through production. Drive continuous improvement and inspire teams to refine ways of working. Lead root cause analyses and improvement programs to address quality issues comprehensively. Support product & process design decisions with quality input. Work on supplier quality: assessing, improving, and managing supplier-related quality issues. Identify major areas for improvement, take full ownership of those areas, and help improve the overall performance of the organization. Arbeidsvoorwaarden A competitive gross salary in the range of € 4.000 – € 6.500 per month excluding holiday allowance, depending on experience and results. Relocation package from Xelvin: Finding the right new challenge, flight to the Netherlands paid by Xelvin,

arrangement of documentation that is needed to work in the Netherlands and guidance from our housing consultant to find accommodation. 27 paid holidays in addition to public holidays, pension scheme and travel allowance. Holiday allowance of 8 % of annual salary. A job with perspective. After the Xelvin contract you will be on contract with your employer. Career-oriented education, training or courses. Excellent employment conditions, both primary and secondary. Onboarding & benefits Your first house in the Netherlands will be arranged by Xelvin, with the help of our relocation team. Furthermore: A relocation assistance allowance will be paid to you, to cover the cost of relocating to the Netherlands. You (and your family) will be picked up at the airport or train station and will be taken to your new house. Onboarding: we’ll advise you on how to set up a Dutch bank account, apply for health insurance, getting a Dutch BSN number, registering at a dentist and general practitioner and other useful or necessary cases to arrange. We organize a few social gatherings in the year with all Xelvin employees and recruited engineers. jobs.occupation: Salad Production Worker/ Cold Storage Environment
jobs.description:
Location: Purmerend, Netherlands
Working Conditions: Cold storage at 8°C
Job Description:
We are seeking dedicated and motivated individuals to work in our salad production facility.
This role involves working in a chilled environment, ensuring the preparation and packaging of fresh, high-quality salads.
Main Responsibilities:
- Preparing, packaging, and conducting quality checks on salad products.
- Operating production machinery (training provided).
- Maintaining cleanliness and order in the workplace.
- Following all hygiene and safety protocols.
Requirements:
- Basic communication skills in English are required.
- Availability for a minimum of 6 months, with potential for vacation during the contract.
- Willingness to work flexible shifts depending on production needs.
- Ability to work both independently and as part of a team.
Working Hours:
Day Shifts:
- From 8:30 to 17:00 or 7:00 to 15:00.
Night/Evening Shifts:
- Start at 18:00 and finish upon task completion, depending on the volume of orders (typically between 2:00 and 4:00).
Additional Compensation:
- Overtime (above 40 hours): 125% pay rate.
- Sundays and Public Holidays: 200% pay rate.
Night Shifts:
- From 19:00 to 23:00 – 125% pay rate.
- From 23:00 to 06:00 – 140% pay rate.
- Sundays starting at 23:00 – 140% pay rate.
What We Offer:
A competitive base hourly wage, with bonuses for evening, night, and holiday shifts.
Vacation pay (8% of gross annual salary) and paid vacation days in line with Dutch labor law.
A supportive and diverse team environment.
Opportunities for training and professional development.
Assistance with housing and transportation if necessary.
If you are ready, apply today and become part of our team!
